results.name: Profile editor, channel details, sharing and reporting pass browser verification
Development StrictMode, clipboard denial and cancelled Web Share recover correctly
Redis login survives the API restart
Stored channel profile and stable ID survive the API restart
The previous handle still resolves to the same channel after restart
Received reports persist and duplicate submissions remain blocked after restart

limits: Single PC, loopback and headless Edge
No native mobile browser or Caddy HTTPS verification
Clipboard and Web Share payloads are checked with browser spies; no external messages are sent
No global video/view counters or operator report review UI
